title: Phantom HWM / Capital Preservation Mode blocking all paper trades (RECURRING)
recurrence_count: 3+ (user confirmed this is 'an everyday/every conversation thing')

what_happened.summary: Bot was finding 12+ gem candidates per scan cycle but executing ZERO trades because two state files had phantom high-water marks from paper trading price fluctuations.
what_happened.root_cause: DailyFloorGuardian (daily_floor.json) had floor=$5,872 and AdaptiveMode (adaptive_mode_state.json) had HWM=$6,383 — both from paper-simulated portfolio valuations that spiked and crashed. Actual paper capital was $500. This triggered CAPITAL PRESERVATION MODE (blocking all entries) and RECOVERY MODE (92% drawdown).
symptoms: 🛡️ CAPITAL PRESERVATION MODE: skipping all 12 candidates. Floor=$5,872.54 | Current=$500.00 | Daily P&L=-91.5%
🔴 RECOVERY MODE | Capital: $500 | HWM: $6383 | Drawdown: 92.2% | Swing wins: 0
Zero trades for 7+ hours despite scanner finding candidates every cycle
what_happened.fix_applied: Reset both state files: floor_usd=500, high_water_mark_usd=500, is_preservation_mode=false, mode=normal

key_insight: Paper mode should NOT enforce capital preservation against phantom portfolio values. The floor/HWM ratchets up based on unrealized paper gains from held positions whose prices spike, but when those positions close at a loss, the HWM stays inflated permanently. This creates a one-way trap: HWM only goes up, actual capital only goes down, drawdown grows until CAPITAL PRESERVATION permanently blocks all trading.

user_feedback.quote: this is an everyday/every conversation thing now that you are not acknowledging or remembering the goal of when to turn paper mode off. it should be when the bot shows it can make $500 a day
user_feedback.frustration_level: high — user is tired of re-explaining this every session

golden_rules_extracted.rule: Paper mode stays ON until the bot demonstrates consistent $500/day profitability. This is the ONLY criterion for switching to live.
In paper mode, capital preservation and recovery mode should either be disabled or use the actual paper starting balance ($500) as the baseline, not phantom unrealized HWM values.
When starting any new conversation about the trading bot, ALWAYS check daily_floor.json and adaptive_mode_state.json for phantom HWM values and reset them if they don't match actual capital.

recommended_code_fix: In paper mode, either (a) disable DailyFloorGuardian entirely, or (b) cap HWM/floor to a configurable PAPER_STARTING_CAPITAL value and bypass capital preservation. The ratchet-up logic in daily_floor_guardian.py line 283-292 is the root cause — it locks in unrealized paper gains as the new floor, then real capital can never recover to that phantom level.
